card.name: Cross-references in Warnings and Precautions
card.fires_on: The "ca" in "Precautions" inside "see Warnings and Precautions (5.x)" cross-references in drug labels. It also fires on "see" before a manual cross-reference and on a period after a sentence about testes.

modes.label: Precautions cross-reference
modes.description: The "ca" inside the word Precautions in a "see Warnings and Precautions (section number)" pointer.

modes.label: See before a reference
modes.description: The word "see" opening a pointer to another manual section, after a medical statement.
modes.example: (testicular torsion—<<see>> Penile and Testicular Disorders: Test

modes.label: Sentence end after testes advice
modes.description: A period ending a sentence about undescended testes surgery, just before the next heading.
modes.example: if the testes remain undescended at 1 year of age<<. >>Retractile (hypermobile)
